scope: Initial advisory contract proposal, before addition of runtime-source guard; reviewer did not execute tests

findings.problem: Contract guidance on decisive assessment requirements risks nudging agents into template boilerplate or hallucinated rationale if guidance contains illustrative threshold/effect values.
findings.fix: Restrict contract guidance strictly to structural field names, required types, and validator locators, completely omitting illustrative data, sample thresholds, or narrative examples.

findings.problem: Fallback to summary/counts under the 4096-byte cap could lead agents to assume unlisted descendants are valid unless truncation semantics are unequivocal.
findings.fix: Enforce explicit truncation metadata (e.g. `truncated: true` and state.json reference pointer) whenever descending dependency lists are condensed to counts.

review.reason: The proposal strictly preserves historical immutability, retains all schema7 phase/author/call budgets under schema8, does not weaken engine gates or create schema aliases, and limits intervention to static contract clarity and read-only dependency diagnostics.
